entries.headline: Five USAF transports and Customs aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five U.S. Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States alongside a U.S. Customs surveillance aircraft. It characterised the activity as unusually high for the hour but did not identify any mission.

entries.headline: USAF surveillance plane and six transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a U.S. Air Force surveillance aircraft and six military transport aircraft airborne over the United States. It said no coded broadcasts had been detected during that hour.

entries.headline: USAF surveillance and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a U.S. Air Force surveillance aircraft and a nuclear command jet airborne over the United States alongside multiple cargo transports. It said no coded radio broadcasts had been detected during that hour.

entries.headline: F-16 emergency squawk sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a sighting credited to JackUSAF identifying an F-16 with hex code AE4980 broadcasting squawk 7700. The post did not give a location or confirm the cause of the emergency code.

entries.headline: USAF transports and surveillance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and a surveillance aircraft spotted earlier. It separately mentioned reports of a cockpit incident on a Middle East flight; the visible post did not identify a connection.

entries.headline: Three surveillance aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported three military surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea. It separately relayed a reported Middle East flight diversion to Saudi Arabia after a cockpit incident; no connection to the military aircraft was stated.

entries.headline: Four transports and two NATO radar aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and two NATO radar aircraft airborne, with one of each over the North Sea. It also noted a surveillance aircraft spotted earlier, without confirming any mission.

entries.headline: US aircraft and NATO radar activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six U.S. military cargo and surveillance aircraft airborne and NATO radar activity over the North Sea. The post also mentioned a reported Dubai–Tel Aviv flight diversion; the visible text did not identify the military aircraft’s missions.

entries.headline: Taiwan-area air activity reported elevated
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported air activity near Taiwan at nearly four times its usual level. It also reported a commercial flight diversion to Saudi Arabia following a cockpit incident; no link between the two events was stated.

entries.headline: Pacific transports and North Sea radar aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple U.S. military transport aircraft over the Pacific region, a NATO radar aircraft over the North Sea, and a surveillance aircraft near the Middle East. The post did not confirm their missions.

entries.headline: West Pacific activity reported above normal
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported military air activity near Taiwan at about 3.4 times its usual level, five heavy transport aircraft airborne, and a U.S. surveillance aircraft over the North Sea. Its post did not identify their missions.

entries.headline: Transports and radar aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a NATO radar aircraft airborne. It also said a surveillance aircraft had been spotted over the North Sea earlier; no missions were confirmed.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 reported on the ground at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 on the ground at Orange Park, Florida, United States. Its mission and reason for being there were not confirmed.

entries.headline: P-8 reported off the ground at Fruit Cove
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Fruit Cove, Florida, United States. The alert did not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 reported off the ground at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Orange Park, Florida, United States. The alert did not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: Another P-8 departure alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted a separate P-8 off-ground alert at Orange Park, Florida, United States. The post did not establish whether it concerned the same aircraft as its later Orange Park alert.

entries.headline: P-8 reported on the ground at Lexington Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 on the ground at Lexington Park, Maryland, United States. The alert did not show a callsign or confirm the aircraft’s mission or reason for being there.

entries.headline: P-3 departure at Port Hueneme
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-3 off the ground at Port Hueneme, United States. The alert did not show a callsign or confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Chetwayi
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Chetwayi, with the location marked IN in the alert. The post’s expanded prose conflicts on the place name, so no broader location or mission is inferred.

entries.headline: B-52 departure near Red Chute
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a B-52 off the ground near Red Chute, Louisiana, United States. The alert did not confirm the aircraft’s destination or mission.

entries.headline: NATO02 E3TF departure at Albacete
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported E3TF callsign NATO02 off the ground at Albacete, Spain. The alert did not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: BOE36 E737 departure at Lossiemouth
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported E737 callsign BOE36 off the ground at Lossiemouth, United Kingdom. The alert did not establish its operator, destination or mission.

entries.headline: F-16 identification system report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked Defence Blog report about clearance for BAE Systems’ AN/APX-127(V)1 identification system for F-16 aircraft. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: F/A-XX contract report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked Defence Blog report saying Boeing had beaten Northrop Grumman for a U.S. Navy F/A-XX fighter contract. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.
